annotation.title_en: Regulations on Market Supervision and Administration Offices
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院 (State Council of the People's Republic of China)
annotation.summary_en: State Council Decree No. 846 promulgating regulations on market supervision and administration offices, which are county-level dispatched agencies. It sets their duties, staffing, training, accountability and standardisation, effective 1 November 2026, replacing the Industrial and Commercial Administration Offices Regulations. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Offices are dispatched agencies of county-level market regulators and act in their name
Duties include registration, food, drug and product-quality supervision, complaints and enforcement
Staff training, accountability and periodic assessment required
Counties to improve informatisation and intelligent supervision
Effective 1 Nov 2026; replaces the Industrial and Commercial Administration Offices Regulations
